items.t: 23 houses sold in Glenwood, Port Coquitlam at a median of $1,300,000 (middle half $1,129,000 to $1,381,000). A typical house in Glenwood, Port Coquitlam spent 27 days on the market and closed at 96.1% of the asking price.

In Glenwood, Port Coquitlam, townhomes sold at a median of $765,000 across 19 sales, and the middle half closed between $673,000 and $930,000. The median townhome sat 21 days and sold for 97.2% of list.
Glenwood, Port Coquitlam: 45 condos sold at a median of $512,000, with the middle half between $426,000 and $580,000. The median condo took 36 days to sell and closed at 97.1% of list.

9 duplexes sold in Glenwood, Port Coquitlam at a median of $1,028,571 (middle half $951,428 to $1,088,888). A typical duplex in Glenwood, Port Coquitlam spent 14 days on the market and closed at 95.5% of the asking price.

How Glenwood compares with the rest of Port Coquitlam

items.t: Houses in Glenwood have the 4th highest median of 10 Port Coquitlam sub-areas, $1,300,000. Birchland Manor is lowest at $1,112,000 and Riverwood highest at $1,410,000. Woodland Acres PQ ($1,295,000) sits just below and Mary Hill ($1,305,000) sits just above.
Townhomes in Glenwood have the lowest median of the 5 Port Coquitlam sub-areas, $765,000, below Mary Hill at $860,000; the highest is Central Port Coquitlam at $999,950.
Condos in Glenwood have the lowest median of the 3 Port Coquitlam sub-areas, $512,000, below Central Port Coquitlam at $572,500; the highest is Riverwood at $638,000.
